title: 第1716章 你所说的条件我没有任何的兴趣第1715章 刚刚我说错了
lines: 仙梵城。
林铮则是进入仙梵城，到处都是人山人海，很是繁华。
全程赶路，林铮实在是有些累了，所以看到仙梵城，则是第一时间进入仙梵城看看。
猛然停下脚步，林铮转身看着远处的黑牛。
因为有了之前的事情，相信黑牛肯定不敢随意出手，但是黑牛肯定却不愿意选择放弃。
不单单是因为仇恨问题，甚至还有着所谓的涅盘丹，毕竟对于武者来说，涅盘丹实在太重要了。
任何武者吞服涅盘丹，便可以顺利突破自身极限，哪怕是一个阶位都是非常值得的事情。
林铮的意思很简单，那就是人不犯我我不犯人。
既然黑牛想要跟着自己，那么就让黑牛跟着。
在林铮看来，等到黑牛跟着自己前往幽阙宫，到时候他便可以借助幽阙宫斩草除根。
也就是说，只要黑牛不选择主动挑衅，他也懒得去找麻烦。
黑牛朝着林铮走来。
“林兄弟，我想要和你谈谈。”
“我和你有好谈的？”
“放心，我黑牛最尊重强者，你不单单是有着大罗金仙分身，更是提前掌握领域力量，我很佩服。”
林铮肯定不会选择相信黑牛的话，不过还是那句话，只要黑牛不出手，他也懒得给自己招惹麻烦，完全没有必要的事情。
“你想说什么快点，我还有事。”
黑牛没有丝毫的愤怒，反而笑着说道：“林兄弟，之前的事情都是误会，我黑牛愿意结交你这个朋友，希望你能看在朋友的份上，送我一枚涅盘丹，日后不管有什么事情，我都会出手相助你。”
直接要？
甚至不是想要买，真是狗改不了吃屎。
林铮脸上流露出的厌恶毫无掩饰，不耐烦的说道：“黑牛，我没有兴趣和你成为朋友，你想要涅盘丹没有问题，拿出你的宝物来换取。”
看着离去的身影，黑牛的眼神瞬间阴沉下来，刚刚的他恨不得立刻将林铮碎尸万段，只是最终还是隐忍下来。
黑牛没有十足的把握，肯定不会继续出手，毕竟林铮有着分身，外加自身的领域叠加，自己肯定是无法做到绝对镇压。
不愿意选择放弃，黑牛对于林铮手里的涅盘丹，外加林铮掌握的领域，应对起来可是最麻烦的事情。
幽阙宫。
自从宫主沈烟鸢消失以后，再也没有人成为宫主，而一切事务则是由副宗主清芜管理。
“副宫主，这一批的弟子已经全部回来，还是没有宫主的消息。”
一声叹息！
清芜满脸的无奈，说道：“宫主消失这么多年，生命令牌依然存在，说明宫主并未陨落。”
“难道宫主出现了意外？”
“宫主，传言宫主被封印在锁帝图内，不知道此事到底是真是假。”
“虽然没有见过锁帝图主人，但是此人就是个变态，就算是他封印了宫主，但故意泄露出去，就是故意挑衅我幽阙宫。”
content_en:
Immortal Brahma City.
Lin Zheng entered Xianfan City. There were huge crowds of people everywhere and it was very prosperous.
Lin Zheng was really tired after traveling all the way, so when he saw Xianfan City, he immediately entered Xianfan City to take a look.
Lin Zheng suddenly stopped and turned around to look at the black cow in the distance.
Because of what happened before, I believe Hei Niu would not dare to take action at will, but Hei Niu would definitely not want to give up.
Not only because of the issue of hatred, there is even the so-called Nirvana Pill. After all, for warriors, the Nirvana Pill is too important.
Any warrior who swallows the Nirvana Pill can successfully break through his own limits. Even if he only reaches one level, it is very worthwhile.
Lin Zheng's meaning is very simple, that is, I will not offend others unless they offend me.
Since Hei Niu wants to follow him, then let Hei Niu follow him.
In Lin Zheng's opinion, when Hei Niu follows him to Youque Palace, he can use Youque Palace to eradicate the problem.
In other words, as long as Hei Niu doesn't choose to take the initiative to provoke, he won't bother to look for trouble.
Black Bull walked towards Lin Zheng.
"Brother Lin, I want to talk to you."
"Do you and I have anything to talk about?"
"Don't worry, I, Hei Niu, respect the strong the most. Not only do you have the Daluo Golden Immortal clone, but you have also mastered the power of the field in advance. I admire you very much."
Lin Zheng would definitely not choose to believe Hei Niu's words, but again, as long as Hei Niu didn't take action, he wouldn't bother to cause trouble for himself. It was completely unnecessary.
"Hurry up what you want to say, I have something else to do."
Hei Niu showed no anger at all. Instead, he said with a smile: "Brother Lin, what happened before was all a misunderstanding. I, Hei Niu, am willing to make you a friend. I hope you can give me a Nirvana Pill for the sake of being a friend. No matter what happens in the future, I will help you."
Want it directly?
I don’t even want to buy it. It’s true that a dog can’t change its habit of eating shit.
The disgust on Lin Zheng's face was undisguised, and he said impatiently: "Hei Niu, I have no interest in becoming friends with you. It's okay for you to want the Nirvana Pill, just give me your treasure in exchange."
Looking at the leaving figure, Hei Niu's eyes instantly darkened. Just now, he wanted to cut Lin Zheng into pieces immediately, but in the end he endured it.
Black Bull is not completely sure and will definitely not continue to take action. After all, Lin Zheng has a clone, and with his own domain superimposition, he will definitely not be able to absolutely suppress it.
Unwilling to choose to give up, Black Niu had the most troublesome thing to deal with the Nirvana Pill in Lin Zheng's hands, plus the domain that Lin Zheng controlled.
~~~~~~~~~
Youque Palace.
Since the disappearance of Palace Master Shen Yanyuan, no one has become the Palace Master, and all affairs are managed by Deputy Sect Master Qing Wu.
"Deputy Palace Master, all the disciples of this group have returned, but there is still no news from the Palace Master."
A sigh!
Qingwu said with helplessness on his face: "The Palace Master has disappeared for so many years, but the life order sign still exists, which means that the Palace Master has not died."
"Did something happen to the palace master?"
"Palace Master, it is rumored that the Palace Master is sealed in the Emperor Lock Map. I don't know whether this is true or not."
"Although I have never met the owner of Emperor Lock, this person is a pervert. Even if he sealed the palace owner, but deliberately leaked it, he is deliberately provoking me, Youque Palace."
title_en: Chapter 1716 I have no interest in the conditions you mentioned. Chapter 1715 I just said something wrong.
